text:
Data Scientist at NexaFlow Solutions, focused on unlocking value from complex data in the SaaS space. Over the past year, I’ve leaned into Python and Pandas to streamline data cleaning and exploration, turning raw insights into actionable strategies. Jupyter notebooks have been a staple for iterative analysis, balancing speed and transparency in cross-functional projects.  

When tackling business challenges, NumPy’s numerical power helps refine models, while SQL analytics keeps me grounded in the data’s foundation. The rhythm of transforming messy datasets into coherent narratives feels like solving puzzles with real-world impact.  

Collaboration is key—whether aligning with product teams to refine metrics or supporting growth initiatives with data-driven hypotheses. I’m always curious about how technology shapes user experiences, and I thrive in environments where experimentation meets practical outcomes.  

Looking ahead, I’m excited to dive deeper into optimizing workflows and exploring how data can drive smarter decisions. The SaaS landscape is dynamic, and I’m committed to growing alongside it—one dataset at a time.
